metadata.framework: Flask (primary dataretriever file-serving) + Django (scopeserver) + Tornado/sockjs (JSON Blaster) + custom XDR RPC (diamondservers/proxy)
notes: Pass 1 (CWE-022/023/036/073, Path Traversal) only; Phase 2 was NOT started.

Labels were produced by LLM reasoning (glm-5.3 via Claude Code CLI) over the real opendiamond_vuln source tree in 14 batches (S1-S7 source candidates, K1-K7 sink candidates); label_gen.py is a serialization helper only.
Input rows: 168 source-candidate rows and 281 sink-candidate rows from iris/extraction/*.csv; deduplicated into 375 unique labeled sites (146 sources + 229 sinks).

Dedup rules: (a) source rows of the same (file, line, callable, argIndex) - e.g. the BinaryExpr and StringLiteral extraction shapes of each route/handler parameter - merged; (b) sink rows of the same (file, line, callable) - api and ast double rows of one call site, and repeated rows of one call - merged; (c) same-line distinct callables (fdopen/open/join at server/filter.py:772-773) kept separate. No raw row was dropped without a mapping - see labels_raw_pass1.json.

Exclusion rationale: tests/, setup.py and the nested opendiamond-db/ tree were excluded at extraction time (WORKFLOW.md 4.3.2); VULNERABILITY_AUDIT_REPORT.md and path_traversal_sinks.csv at the repo root were NOT read (experiment independence). test_store.py and test_utils.py are runtime dataretriever modules (BASEURL 'cocktailtest', registered via the DATASTORE config in dataretriever/__main__.py) and were labeled as production code, not test fixtures.

Sanitizers: exactly one confirmed - werkzeug.utils.safe_join in augment_store.py:156 (the only store whose /obj, /id and /root channels are contained). All other stores build paths with a bare os.path.join(DATAROOT, user_path).

Authorization is contextual, not sanitization: ScopeCookie signature verification (scope.py:96-136), Tornado route regexes and Django @permission_required limit who can reach a channel, not what a path may contain (django.md section 8).

Server-side generated keys (sha256 hexdigests from BlobCache.add / put_search / _object_key) and operator-level inputs (TMPDIR, DIAMOND_CONFIG, HOME, config files, CLI argv) are not attacker-controlled path sources in this threat model.

Cross-service chains (Django form -> generate_cookie -> scope cookie -> dataretriever objectlist file: URIs; proxy -> downstream diamond servers) exceed a single-DB taint pass; their endpoints are labeled and flagged as Phase 2 MySummaries candidates in phase1_review.md.

Wrapper: obj_path -> safe_join(DATAROOT, obj_path). Propagates the untrusted route path to every augment_store consumer, but the terminal step is the safe_join sanitizer (:156) - taint passes through only within the contained result.

werkzeug.utils.safe_join(DATAROOT, obj_path): rejects absolute filenames and any '..' segment that would escape the base directory (posixpath.normpath containment; raises NotFound in werkzeug). The only real containment guard in the whole dataretriever; guards get_scope rootdir, /id/<path:object_path> and /obj/<path:obj_path> in this store. Caveats: symlink contents are not resolved (a symlink inside DATAROOT may point outside), and a None return from old werkzeug versions would need caller handling - here callers pass the result straight on.

flask send_file(path) with path = safe_join(DATAROOT, obj_path): a real file-serving sink, but this augment_store /obj channel is guarded by the safe_join at :156, which rejects escaping paths before the file is served.

sig flows into the rescue path: os.rename(self._path(sig) + GC_SUFFIX, self._path(sig)) - propagation of the sig-controlled path into fs operations.

os.rename(path + GC_SUFFIX, path) in _try_with_rescue: both names derive from _path(sig) with a client-influenced sig; a traversal sig renames paths outside the cache dir. Affects rescue timing, low direct impact.

open(os.path.join(basedir, sig.lower()), 'rb'): reads the blob file at a sig-derived path. sig is client-supplied (blaster blob: URI path, XDR sha256: URI) and only .lower()-ed - no hex validation, so '../' in sig escapes basedir and reads arbitrary files.
